[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security and privacy"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Games run in a sandboxed iframe with a content security policy that blocks network access; exporte"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"d files make no network requests.
- The only things sent off your machine are the prompts — and the "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"reference picture, if you give one — to the image service you choose.
- The share link is read-only,"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" serves just that game's build, and closes after the time you set (30 minutes by default). Local lin"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ks listen on your local network only; public links listen on `127.0.0.1` only and tunnel through Clo"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"udflare (`trycloudflare.com`) after you approve.
- Publishing to GitHub Pages (`game_studio_publish`"},{"id":"p24s7","text":") uses your local signed-in `gh` CLI (the plugin never touches your GitHub token), uploads only the "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"built HTML to a **public** repository after you approve, and refuses to write to any existing reposi"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"tory that does not carry its `.dsh-game-studio.json` marker.
- Online game sources run on the provid"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"er's own site inside a sandboxed iframe (`sandbox="allow-scripts"`) without access to DSH or your wo"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"rkspace, and are never copied or forwarded when exporting or publishing your local game wall.
- API "},{"id":"p24s12","text":"keys are read from DSH credentials or the environment and are never written into projects, logs or t"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"d from DSH credentials or the environment and are never written into projects, logs or tool results."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1` or later (web or desktop), Node.js `24.11` or later.
- Google Chrome or M"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"icrosoft Edge on the same computer for playtests.
- For AI art, either an OpenAI API key or the Code"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"x CLI signed in. Without either, games still work with their code-drawn characters.
- Optional: `clo"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"udflared` (`brew install cloudflared` on macOS) for temporary public share links; `gh` (`brew instal"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"l gh` and `gh auth login`) for publishing to GitHub Pages."}],"truncated":true}
